Measured make-ahead batches · PM

Sauces

Every recipe below makes enough for approximately 4–6 bowls for two people across several dinners. Start with 1–2 tablespoons per bowl; add more after tasting.

About ¾–1 cup each

Creamy

Blend until smooth. Add cold water one tablespoon at a time only after the main ingredients are combined.

4–6 bowls

Parsley–mint green sauce

  • ¾ cup cottage cheese or Greek yogurt
  • 1 packed cup parsley
  • 2 Tbsp mint
  • 2 Tbsp lemon juice
  • 2 Tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tsp Dijon + 1 tsp GF tamari
  • Chili, salt + 2–4 Tbsp water

With: salmon, tofu, turkey, broccoli, corn and feta.

4–6 bowls

Egg-free spicy aioli

  • ¾ cup Greek yogurt, cottage cheese or vegan mayo
  • 1½ Tbsp chili-garlic sauce
  • 1 Tbsp lime juice
  • 1 Tbsp olive oil
  • ¼ tsp salt
  • 1–2 Tbsp water, if needed

With: salmon, shrimp, tofu and Mexican bowls.

4–6 bowls

Lemon-herb tahini

  • ½ cup tahini
  • 3 Tbsp lemon juice
  • 1 Tbsp olive oil
  • ¼ cup cold water, plus more as needed
  • 2 Tbsp chopped parsley or dill
  • ½ tsp salt

With: white fish, chickpeas, cauliflower and feta.

4–6 bowls

Egg-free Caesar

  • ¾ cup Greek yogurt or blended cottage cheese
  • ¼ cup finely grated parmesan
  • 2 Tbsp lemon juice
  • 1 tsp Dijon
  • 1 small grated garlic clove
  • Black pepper + 2–4 Tbsp water

With: romaine, broccoli, Brussels sprouts and Pacha croutons.

About ⅔–¾ cup each

Vinaigrettes

Put everything in a jar and shake. Taste on a leaf—not from a spoon—then adjust salt or acidity.

4–6 bowls

Mediterranean red wine + lemon

  • 3 Tbsp red-wine vinegar
  • 2 Tbsp lemon juice
  • 1 small grated garlic clove
  • 7 Tbsp olive oil
  • ½ tsp salt + black pepper

With: green salads, fish, feta, tomato, cucumber and parsley.

4–6 bowls

Yuzu–ginger

  • 3 Tbsp yuzu vinegar
  • 1 Tbsp lime juice
  • 1 Tbsp coconut aminos or GF tamari
  • 1 tsp grated ginger
  • 6 Tbsp olive oil or 5 Tbsp olive + 1 Tbsp sesame oil
  • Chili to taste

With: salmon, shrimp, tofu, cucumber and carrot.

4–6 bowls

Black-currant Dijon

  • 3 Tbsp black-currant vinegar
  • 2 tsp Dijon
  • 6 Tbsp olive oil
  • ¼ tsp salt + black pepper

With: salmon, feta, walnuts, pomegranate and roasted vegetables.

4–6 bowls

Sherry–sage

  • 3 Tbsp sherry vinegar
  • 2 tsp Dijon
  • 1 tsp finely chopped sage
  • ½ small grated garlic clove
  • 6 Tbsp olive oil
  • ½ tsp salt + black pepper

With: chicken, turkey, mushrooms, Brussels sprouts and walnuts.

4–6 bowls

Apple-cider + Mexican mint

  • 3 Tbsp apple-cider vinegar
  • 1 Tbsp lime juice
  • 1 tsp finely chopped Mexican mint / Cuban oregano
  • ¼ tsp cumin
  • 6 Tbsp olive oil
  • ½ tsp salt

With: corn, beans, turkey, mushrooms and cucumber.

4–6 bowls

Champagne–dill

  • 3 Tbsp champagne vinegar
  • 1 Tbsp lemon juice
  • 1 tsp Dijon
  • 2 Tbsp chopped dill
  • 6 Tbsp olive oil
  • ½ tsp salt + black pepper

With: haddock, bass, salmon, cucumber and feta.

4–6 bowls

Cucumber–lemon

  • 3 Tbsp cucumber-lemon balsamic
  • 1 Tbsp lemon juice
  • 6 Tbsp olive oil
  • ¼ tsp salt + black pepper

With: cucumber, greens, smoked salmon and dill.

Vinegar pairing guide

Red wine

Tomato, feta, cucumber, parsley, fish.

Sherry

Mushrooms, poultry, Brussels sprouts, walnuts.

Yuzu

Salmon, shrimp, tofu, cucumber, ginger.

Apple cider

Turkey, corn, cabbage, cauliflower, cumin.

Champagne

Delicate fish, dill, cucumber, greens.

Black currant

Salmon, feta, pomegranate, walnuts.

Dark-chocolate balsamic is a sparing finishing accent, not a main dressing. Skip balsamic glazes because of added sugar.
